<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <soapenv:Body>
    <pr:processPaymentResponse xmlns:pr="http://payrail.example.com/v1">
      <pr:transactionId>TXN-{{randomValue type='ALPHANUMERIC' length=12 uppercase=true}}</pr:transactionId>
      <pr:responseCode>APPROVED</pr:responseCode>
      <pr:authorisedAmount>{{xPath request.body "//*[local-name()='processPaymentRequest']/*[local-name()='amount']/text()"}}</pr:authorisedAmount>
      <pr:maskedCardNumber>************{{regexExtract (xPath request.body "//*[local-name()='card']/*[local-name()='cardNumber']/text()") '[0-9]{4}$'}}</pr:maskedCardNumber>
      <pr:processedAt>{{now format="yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}}</pr:processedAt>
    </pr:processPaymentResponse>
  </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <soapenv:Body>
    <pr:processPaymentResponse xmlns:pr="http://payrail.example.com/v1">
      <pr:transactionId>TXN-{{randomValue type='ALPHANUMERIC' length=12 uppercase=true}}</pr:transactionId>
      <pr:responseCode>APPROVED</pr:responseCode>
      <pr:authorisedAmount>{{xPath request.body "//*[local-name()='processPaymentRequest']/*[local-name()='amount']/text()"}}</pr:authorisedAmount>
      <pr:maskedAccountNumber>******{{regexExtract (xPath request.body "//*[local-name()='bankAccount']/*[local-name()='accountNumber']/text()") '[0-9]{4}$'}}</pr:maskedAccountNumber>
      <pr:processedAt>{{now format="yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}}</pr:processedAt>
    </pr:processPaymentResponse>
  </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <soapenv:Body>
    <pr:processPaymentResponse xmlns:pr="http://payrail.example.com/v1">
      <pr:transactionId>TXN-{{randomValue type='ALPHANUMERIC' length=12 uppercase=true}}</pr:transactionId>
      <pr:responseCode>DECLINED</pr:responseCode>
      <pr:declineReason>Card declined by issuer</pr:declineReason>
      <pr:processedAt>{{now format="yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}}</pr:processedAt>
    </pr:processPaymentResponse>
  </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <soapenv:Body>
    <pr:processPaymentResponse xmlns:pr="http://payrail.example.com/v1">
      <pr:transactionId>TXN-{{randomValue type='ALPHANUMERIC' length=12 uppercase=true}}</pr:transactionId>
      <pr:responseCode>DECLINED</pr:responseCode>
      <pr:declineReason>Insufficient funds</pr:declineReason>
      <pr:processedAt>{{now format="yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}}</pr:processedAt>

  </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <soapenv:Body>
    <soapenv:Fault>
      <faultcode>soapenv:Server</faultcode>
      <faultstring>PROCESSING_ERROR: the payment could not be processed</faultstring>
      <detail>
        <pr:PayRailFault xmlns:pr="http://payrail.example.com/v1">
          <pr:faultCode>PROCESSING_ERROR</pr:faultCode>
          <pr:faultText>The payment could not be processed. Retry later.</pr:faultText>
        </pr:PayRailFault>
      </detail>
    </soapenv:Fault>
  </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <soapenv:Body>
    <soapenv:Fault>
      <faultcode>soapenv:Client</faultcode>
      <faultstring>VALIDATION: paymentMethod must contain a card or a bankAccount</faultstring>
      <detail>
        <pr:PayRailFault xmlns:pr="http://payrail.example.com/v1">
          <pr:faultCode>VALIDATION</pr:faultCode>
          <pr:faultText>paymentMethod must contain a card or a bankAccount</pr:faultText>
        </pr:PayRailFault>
      </detail>
    </soapenv:Fault>
  </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>
